about: National grids for the presentation CRS (invariant 10, CLAUDE.md; skills/cartography/SKILL.md section 2). One run shows coordinates in one system: the grid of the region holding most of the site, else WGS 84 / UTM. Read only by js/presentation.js. Each region names its real outline (outline.layer: uk-areas or countries, in data/ref; names: the outline features' names). crs.code and crs.base are EPSG codes, checked against the EPSG registry at run time (kind, not deprecated, base CRS, area of use); a mismatch falls back to UTM and says why. crs.projection is the projection alone, on the grid's own datum, for proj4: no datum shift ever appears here (invariant 1). The datum transformation from WGS 84 is chosen at run time by js/epsgtools.js for where the site is. zones: a grid by UTM-style zone (code = code_base + zone; {zone} in the projection is the zone number). covers: names in data/ref/countries.json this region speaks for, so a sample point there that misses the finer outline isn't counted as another country.

grids.source: Ordnance Survey, A guide to coordinate systems in Great Britain; EPSG:27700
OSNI and OSi, Irish Transverse Mercator; EPSG:2157
ICSM, GDA2020 Technical Manual; EPSG:7846 to 7859
